title: fuck diary entry its 2026
content:
It's 4:24 right now. I'm at my home. It's in the morning, right? I'm watching The Social Network. I'm at 41 minutes 27 seconds, to be preicse, at the moment.

My life has been going, having really lots of ups and downs, but the best part is that I'm building. I'm moving forward. I almost got backed by the residency. I just got some new opportunities from some startup accelerators that I'll be interviewing at.

The ultimate goal that we have is YC, because it's not that they give money or something. It's more like the network they provide, the community that it has. That's the kind of emphasis we have towards it.

We might post a launch video kind of something soon enough. I don't know. This is my first blog. I used to write a diary, but I'm too lazy, to be honest. As of now, I have Wispr Flow Pro, so I can just speak out and write it here. Why do I need to take a pen and write a diary? I might write diary when I'm alone or when I am not really in a good mood, but not at the moment, for sure.
